confirmed_issues.name: Hip-Yaw Torque Sign Convention Error
confirmed_issues.description: Hip-yaw torque sign correctness is 0% across all heights. Torque does not oppose error consistently. This causes divergence accumulation at boundary heights.

confirmed_issues.name: Hip-Yaw Divergence at Boundary Heights
confirmed_issues.description: Hip-yaw divergence (left-right asymmetry) is 8x higher at boundary heights (0.3575, 0.2825) vs nominal (0.0447). Legs twist inward/outward at low and high heights.

likely_issues.name: Hip-Roll Saturation at Low Heights
likely_issues.description: Hip-roll abs_max is 3x higher at low_0p300 (0.2167) vs high_0p480 (0.0773). May indicate lateral controller saturation or insufficient authority. Requires correlation with roll_y and controller outputs.

ruled_out_issues.name: WBC Applied to Joints
ruled_out_issues.description: WBC is correctly configured as diagnostic-only. tau_wbc_scaled_per_joint is all zeros. No hidden torque detected.

ruled_out_issues.name: Body Yaw Instability
ruled_out_issues.description: Body yaw is stable across all heights. yaw_drift_max < 0.1 rad at all heights. Classification: stable.

ambiguous_issues.name: Support Position Error Reporting
ambiguous_issues.description: support_position_error column shows 0.0 m but other metrics (com_x, com_y) show some drift. May be a column naming/calculation issue in telemetry.

non_issues.name: Pitch Behavior at Low Heights
non_issues.description: Pitch is larger at low_0p300 but this is expected behavior and will be handled by task-aware pitch control. Not a root cause to fix in this audit.

priority_order.name: Hip-Yaw Torque Sign Convention Error
priority_order.reason: 0% sign correctness means controller cannot correct hip-yaw error. Root cause for divergence accumulation.
priority_order.validation_needed: Verify hip-yaw PD control law sign convention in shape_posture_controller.py

priority_order.name: Hip-Yaw Divergence at Boundary Heights
priority_order.reason: Divergence 8x higher at boundary heights. Likely secondary effect of sign convention error, but may also need mode-based control.
priority_order.validation_needed: Verify hip-yaw sign first, then evaluate if divergence damping is needed

priority_order.name: Hip-Roll Saturation at Low Heights
priority_order.reason: Hip-roll saturation may indicate lateral controller authority limits. Not blocking but may improve with fix.
priority_order.validation_needed: Correlate with roll_y and lateral controller outputs
